title: Lab - Priority classes
description: Make the scheduler evict for a more important Pod.
scenario: Make the scheduler evict for a more important Pod. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - List
tasks.instructions: Which PriorityClasses exist and which is the default?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Create
tasks.instructions: Create PriorityClass high-priority with value 100000 and a description.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Preempt
tasks.instructions: On a full node, create a Pod with priorityClassName high-priority and observe which Pod gets evicted.
tasks.solution:
kubectl run important --image=nginx --overrides='{"spec":{"priorityClassName":"high-priority"}}'
kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | grep -i preempt
